rationale: Based on the Evaluator's feedback, I have adjusted the controller parameters to further improve stability and reduce oscillations. Specifically, I lowered kp from 10 to 9 to reduce potential overshoot and oscillations, and increased ki from 0.2 to 0.3 to help correct steady-state errors. The kd remains at 3 as previously set to maintain good damping. Sensor weights remain at [-1.5, -1, 0, 1, 1.5] as this configuration was recommended and not flagged for change. The base_speed is kept at 1.5 to maintain the target speed. The geometry is unchanged since no issues were reported with it. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations and line loss events, improving overall line tracking and stability without sacrificing speed. I request telemetry measurements including completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to evaluate the impact of these changes.
